name: Moccus

attributes.attribute: identified by the Romans with Mercury

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Maccus is a Continental Celtic god. He is known from one inscription that includes his name. The name may mean pig. The Romans identified the god with their deity Mercury. In the Celtic form the god may be linked to a boar or a pig. Gaulish Maccus sat beside Mercurius under roman rule.

okr.objective: Document Maccus, a Continental Celtic god of the pig.
key_results: Record the one inscription that names the god.
Record the likely pig meaning of the name.
Record the Roman identification with Mercury.
